name: Build Interactive Outcome Story
description: Interactive v2 of an existing visual benchmark; deterministic behavior checks and explicit evidence semantics. Original case remains available for historical comparisons.
prompt: Create a polished responsive self-contained data-story-card-v2.html with inline HTML/CSS/JavaScript only. No network, dependencies or other files. Use accessible keyboard/touch controls, 44px targets and reduced-motion-friendly transitions. Use this exact dataset: baseline pass 2/5=40%, median latency 4.8s, API-equivalent cost unavailable, known-bad rejection 3/4=75%; current pass 4/5=80%, latency 3.1s, API-equivalent estimate $0.42/case, known-bad 4/4=100%. Both latency cohorts have 5 measurements. Provide four metric selectors, paired bars sharing a labeled scale per metric, exact denominators, and a dataset table or readable listing. Missing baseline cost must have no bar and no computed change. Distinguish percentage-point changes, lower-is-better latency/cost and estimated cost from spend. Do not assert causation. Expose window.evaluationDemo.select(key), reset(), getState() returning {metric,baseline,current,unit,lowerIsBetter}; keys pass_rate, latency, cost, known_bad. Reset selects pass_rate. Invalid keys throw. Source and state checks do not certify rendered quality.

benchmark.intent: Evaluate meaningful interaction and information accuracy, beyond static text matching.
